name.es: Huevos de jaula enriquecida, precio al productor (Reino Unido)
name.it: Uova, gabbie arricchite, prezzo al produttore (Regno Unito)

attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Defra.

note.es: Defra, UK egg statistics (Open Government Licence v3.0): Huevos de gallinas en jaula enriquecida, precio medio de la empaquetadora al productor; la fuente da peniques por docena. Serie trimestral (mes final del trimestre) en libras esterlinas. Cambio de unidad hecho por Dehesa Index con aritmetica exacta (peniques a libras), sin estimar nada.
note.en: Defra, UK egg statistics (Open Government Licence v3.0): Eggs from enriched-cage hens, average packer-to-producer price; the source gives pence per dozen. Quarterly series (last month of the quarter) in pounds sterling. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic (pence to pounds); nothing is estimated.
note.fr: Defra, UK egg statistics (Open Government Licence v3.0): Œufs de poules en cage aménagée, prix moyen du centre d'emballage au producteur ; la source donne des pence par douzaine. Série trimestrielle (dernier mois du trimestre) en livres sterling. Changement d'unité effectué par Dehesa Index en arithmétique exacte (pence en livres), sans rien estimer.
note.it: Defra, UK egg statistics (Open Government Licence v3.0): Uova di galline in gabbia arricchita, prezzo medio dal centro di imballaggio al produttore; la fonte indica penny per dozzina. Serie trimestrale (ultimo mese del trimestre) in sterline. Cambio di unità eseguito da Dehesa Index con aritmetica esatta (penny in sterline), senza stimare nulla.
